{
  "name": "form-3d-studio",
  "version": "0.40.0",
  "private": true,
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.13.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "postinstall": "node scripts/patch-three-bvh-csg.mjs",
    "dev": "WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext dev",
    "build": "WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext build",
    "build:netlify-marketing": "node scripts/export-netlify-marketing.mjs",
    "build:netlify-review": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/export-netlify-review.mjs",
    "start": "WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext start",
    "desktop:web:dev": "vite --config vite.desktop.config.ts",
    "desktop:web:build": "vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts",
    "desktop:bundle:validate": "node scripts/validate-desktop-bundle.mjs",
    "desktop:dev": "tauri dev",
    "desktop:build": "tauri build",
    "desktop:build:updater": "node scripts/create-updater-config.mjs && VITE_FORM_UPDATER_ENABLED=1 tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.updater.conf.json",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json",
    "check": "npm run typecheck && npm run lint",
    "test": "npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:budgets",
    "test:unit": "node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/*.test.mjs",
    "test:budgets": "node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/budgets/*.test.mjs",
    "test:react": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/workspace-smoke.test.mjs",
    "test:native": "cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1",
    "test:performance": "cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml medium_ -- --nocapture --test-threads=1",
    "test:performance:js": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-rc.mjs",
    "test:project-container": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-project-container.mjs",
    "test:render": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-render.mjs",
    "test:openvdb": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-openvdb.mjs",
    "test:garment-performance": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-garment.mjs",
    "test:production-cad": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-production-cad.mjs",
    "test:production-drawing": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-production-drawing.mjs",
    "test:production-garment": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-production-garment.mjs",
    "test:production-motion": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-production-motion.mjs",
    "test:bim-performance": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/benchmark-bim.mjs",
    "test:bim-ifc": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/validate-bim-ifc.mjs",
    "test:step:freecad": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/validate-step-freecad.mjs",
    "test:mesh:blender": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/validate-blender-mesh.mjs",
    "audit:native": "scripts/audit-native.sh",
    "audit:wiring": "node scripts/audit-ui-wiring.mjs",
    "audit:theme": "node scripts/audit-theme-cascade.mjs",
    "audit:parity": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/audit-product-parity.mjs",
    "audit:parity:perfect": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/audit-product-parity.mjs --require-perfect",
    "extension:pack": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/sign-extension-package.mjs",
    "lint": "eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern desktop-dist --ignore-pattern .next --ignore-pattern src-tauri/target",
    "release:validate": "node scripts/validate-version.mjs",
    "release:validate:macos": "node scripts/validate-version.mjs && scripts/validate-macos-release.sh",
    "release:preflight:macos": "node scripts/preflight-macos-distribution.mjs",
    "release:manifest": "node scripts/generate-rc-manifest.mjs",
    "release:projects": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/certify-five-projects.mjs",
    "release:update-manifest": "node scripts/create-update-manifest.mjs",
    "release:certify": "node scripts/certify-rc.mjs",
    "release:rc": "npm run release:certify",
    "test:desktop:launch": "scripts/smoke-macos-app.sh",
    "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@momentium/live-review": "file:vendor/momentium-live-review-0.2.1.tgz",
    "@tauri-apps/api": "^2.11.1",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-process": "^2.3.1",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-updater": "^2.10.1",
    "@types/three": "^0.185.1",
    "cannon-es": "^0.20.0",
    "cdt2d": "1.0.0",
    "drizzle-orm": "0.45.2",
    "next": "16.3.8",
    "occt-wasm": "^3.8.1",
    "openvdb": "^0.3.0",
    "react": "^19.2.8",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.8",
    "three": "^0.185.1",
    "three-bvh-csg": "^0.0.18",
    "three-mesh-bvh": "^0.9.13"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@cloudflare/vite-plugin": "^1.52.1",
    "@tailwindcss/postcss": "4.2.1",
    "@tauri-apps/cli": "^2.11.4",
    "@testing-library/dom": "^10.4.1",
    "@testing-library/react": "^16.3.2",
    "@types/node": "22.19.19",
    "@types/react": "19.2.14",
    "@types/react-dom": "19.2.3",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "6.0.2",
    "@vitejs/plugin-rsc": "0.5.26",
    "drizzle-kit": "0.31.10",
    "eslint": "9.39.4",
    "eslint-config-next": "16.3.0",
    "jsdom": "^29.1.1",
    "react-server-dom-webpack": "^19.2.8",
    "tailwindcss": "4.2.1",
    "typescript": "5.9.3",
    "vinext": "0.0.50",
    "vite": "^8.2.1",
    "wrangler": "^4.123.0"
  },
  "type": "module",
  "overrides": {
    "vinext": {
      "image-size": "2.0.4"
    },
    "sharp": "0.35.5"
  }
}
